update.title:
Bash: cd /home/agent/workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute('CREATE TABLE inventory (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)')
cur.execute('INSERT INTO inventory (item_id, quantity, reserved) VALUES (1, 10, 0)')
conn.commit()
conn.close()
print('done')
"

Bash: cd /home/agent/workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
cur = conn.cursor()
print('Tables:', cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\").fetchall())
print('Schema:', cur.execute(\"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='inventory'\").fetchone()[0])
print('Rows:', cur.execute('SELECT * FROM inventory').fetchall())
conn.close()
"
